title: CoreEssentials
description: CoreEssentials adds popular core features used for small-medium servers. This includes configurable Homes, TPA, Spawn, Back, Trash, Inventory & Ender chest Viewing/editing, God mode, Vanish, Random/Wild TP etc. All in an easy to use GUI or with commands.
body:
CoreEssentials GUI & Commands

A lightweight Paper plugin for homes, spawn, TPA, back, wild, and essential server utilities. 


*Player commands

/home, /sethome, /delhome, /homes — personal homes with configurable limits

/spawn, /back — server spawn and return-to-previous-location

/wild (alias /rtp) — random safe teleport with warmup and cooldown

/tpa, /tpahere, /tpaccept, /tpdeny — teleport requests with clickable
accept/deny in chat

/trash — dispose of unwanted items

/core (alias /ce) — GUI menu for all commands. Only shows options that the player has permissions to use.

*Admin commands

/setspawn — set the server spawn point

/vanish, /god — staff utilities (session-only; cleared on logout)

/invsee, /endersee — view and edit player inventories (including offline players)

/homeinspect — browse and teleport to a player's homes

/core reload — reload config without restarting

*Permissions

Player commands are granted by default via coreessentials.player.

Admin commands use individual nodes (coreessentials.vanish, coreessentials.invsee, etc.) or the wildcard coreessentials.*.

Commands can also be toggled on/off in config.yml under commands:.

*Configuration

Everything is in plugins/CoreEssentials/config.yml: And is configurable to suit your needs

Chat messages and prefix

Teleport warmups and cooldowns

Home limits

Wild teleport settings (worlds, radius, safety checks)

GUI menu layout and items

Homes and spawn are stored in homes.yml and spawn.yml in the plugin folder.

Compatibility
One JAR works across Paper 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, and 26.2.

Do not install alongside EssentialsX — both plugins register the same commands (/home, /spawn, /tpa, etc.) and will conflict.
